report: cant add a patient!!! i put the name and press add and it says something red. pls fix asap

plan.understanding: The user opened the New patient form, typed only the patient's full name, clicked 'Add patient', and got a red error instead of a saved patient.
plan.expected: A new patient with only a full name filled in is saved: the app leaves the form and shows the new patient's record (or the patient list), with no red error.
plan.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login. Enter {{account1_email}} in the Email field. Enter {{account1_password}} in the Password field. Click 'Log in'. Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/patients/new. Enter 'Maria Lopez' in the Full name field. Leave Phone, Date of birth, Diagnosis and Notes empty. Click 'Add patient'. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the page shows the patient 'Maria Lopez' and no red error message.
